import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router component that directs claims to different output ports based on ordered rules.
    Rules are evaluated in order; a row goes to the FIRST matching port only.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port "standard" (which is not output in this case).
    """
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize output dataframes
    fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1 -> fast_track
    rule1_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1)
    fast_track = pd.concat([fast_track, claims.loc[rule1_mask, ["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched = matched | rule1_mask
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000 -> high_value
    rule2_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] > 10000)
    high_value = pd.concat([high_value, claims.loc[rule2_mask, ["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched = matched | rule2_mask
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500 -> manual_review
    rule3_mask = (~matched) & ((claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500))
    manual_review = pd.concat([manual_review, claims.loc[rule3_mask, ["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched = matched | rule3_mask
    
    # Remaining rows go to default port "standard" (not output)
    # No output for standard port
    
    # Ensure proper data types
    for df in [fast_track, high_value, manual_review]:
        if len(df) > 0:
            df["claim_id"] = df["claim_id"].astype("int64")
            df["amount"] = df["amount"].astype("float64")
            df["photos_attached"] = df["photos_attached"].astype("int64")
        else:
            df["claim_id"] = df["claim_id"].astype("int64")
            df["amount"] = df["amount"].astype("float64")
            df["photos_attached"] = df["photos_attached"].astype("int64")
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": fast_track.reset_index(drop=True),
        "claims_high_value": high_value.reset_index(drop=True),
        "claims_manual_review": manual_review.reset_index(drop=True)
    }
